recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. FHIR-19308 is satisfied in current build source; any broader duplicate common-UCUM cleanup or display refresh should remain under separate trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-19308 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I STU3 correction asking the editors to review the nine UCUM syntax violations reported through FHIR-17791 and fix the expressions that were invalid.
initial_application: FHIR-17791 was resolved no-change for ballot scope but explicitly created FHIR-19308 for the expression review. Source history shows six related UCUM syntax corrections had already landed in March 2018, commit 545096fed3190b9a3e8c381fd7789f78c50bae6b applied GF#19308 by changing /{hpf}, /{LPF}, and [drp]/{HPF} to /[HPF], /[LPF], and [drp]/[HPF], and a later related history fix corrected mmol/kg{H20} to mmol/kg{H2O} before subsequent UCUM comment cleanup removed annotated variants.
additional_context: The current source/datatypes/valueset-ucum-units.xml no longer enumerates individual UCUM concepts and instead includes the whole http://unitsofmeasure.org system. source/valueset/valueset-ucum-common.xml remains active build source through fhir.ini and the ValueSet examples list. Later UCUM common cleanup and display-normalization work touched the same file but did not reintroduce the old invalid FHIR-19308 expressions.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The corrected /[HPF], /[LPF], and [drp]/[HPF] expressions are present where the historical FHIR-19308 commit fixed them, the old invalid literals are absent from both the worker and current combined branches, and the relevant UCUM atoms are present in source/ucum-essence.xml.

related_jiras.note: Original ballot tracker with the invalid-UCUM attachment; it was resolved no-change for ballot scope and created FHIR-19308 for the actual review/fix work.
Later UCUM common cleanup touched the same source but did not supersede or reintroduce the FHIR-19308 syntax fixes.
